details: R&D for Project Fantasy, exploring scalable GPU-based fluid simulation and other physics-driven effects for AAA production. Designed procedural pipeline infrastructure and tools in Houdini and the Glacier Engine.
Designed a cloud-based routing solution using Bayesian travel-time inference methods used by Denmark’s largest mobile-car-washing provider.
Studied deep-learning-based physics simulation for glacial isostatic adjustment models.
Focused on glacial dynamics. For my master's thesis, I implemented a semi-implicit material point method in Houdini, based on the snow simulation research developed for Frozen.
